summary: Solve the source Maxwellian Taylor/asymptotic matching equations at declared decimal precision, refine simple roots and compute residues.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to named scientific outputs.
identity.definition: I+K=2J; Mpq*pq=B matches source Taylor and inverse-power coefficients. Residue b=P(c)/Qprime(c).80/120-digit precision refinement and independent erfc response checks are separate from matrix conditioning. Numeric ports remain complex128; construction strings retain higher precision.
identity.model: Nonrelativistic Gaussian species; explicit finite-harmonic/rational approximation when applicable.
identity.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
identity.coordinates: Explicit ES dimensionless normalization or EM SI; complex frequency follows exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.
assumptions: A numerical spectrum is not automatically a physically certified mode.

preconditions: Constituent inputs finite and representable in declared numeric ports.
excluded: Repeated/unresolved roots require a higher-order-pole representation.
Finite-J Z accuracy must be checked in the requested domain.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError unless integer J>=1, integer 0<=I<=2J and integer precision>=32; no fixed-table family restriction.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Python/dependency errors propagate; this operator launches no native process and has no native execution receipt.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Linear-solve errors propagate. ArithmeticError for unresolved/repeated/collapsed roots, failed polynomial/linear residual or the bounded 100-step Newton refinement; FloatingPointError for unrepresentable binary64 poles/residues.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No successful result is returned if this operation raises; no partial scientific return is promised.
